about.title: About
about.whatBody: Pitron Shetach brings Israel's night parking grounds and campsites together in one place, so you can find somewhere to sleep tonight without hopping between websites. Search by name or region, see every site on the map, save favorites, and navigate straight there with Waze or Google Maps.
about.accuracyBody: Information about non-official sites comes from a third party and may be inaccurate or out of date: prices, opening hours and even whether a place is still operating can change. We recommend calling to confirm before you set out.
about.independent: Pitron Shetach is an independent project and is not affiliated with the Nature and Parks Authority or with the sites listed here.
about.contactBody: Found a mistake, or know a site we should add? We'd love to hear from you.
